# Entry points lifted out-of-band by tools/lift_extra.py (see its docstring).
# One VA per line. These are ALSO appended to lift_roots_combined.txt so a full
# re-lift picks them up natively; keeping them here makes the cached-lift build
# reproducible without a multi-hour re-lift.

# the server thread.

# --- Direct callees of the entries above that were themselves never lifted

# --- Wave 1b: the same [MISSING] class, but the pc expression survives -O2 as
# `add i32 %.v, %program_counter` with %.v = select/phi of constants (a loop
# back-edge), which a regex for `add i32 %program_counter, K` does NOT match.
# The resolver has to walk add/select/phi. tools/extra_lifted_vas_wave2.txt holds
# the full re-harvest under that resolver.
0x75dca0

# --- CRT transcendental implementations reached through MSVC's runtime
# dispatch: `mov edx, <descriptor>; jmp __ctrandisp2/__cintrindisp2` picks an
# x87 or SSE2 body out of the descriptor and TAIL-JUMPS to it, so the body is
# only ever an indirect target. Descriptors carry a length-prefixed name
# (fmod/sinh/exp/atan2) at +0 and the bodies at +0x10..+0x1c.
# First one that bit: 0x961224 = fmod's x87 partial-remainder loop
# (fxch/fprem/fnstsw/sahf/jp), which no prologue heuristic would ever accept.
0x961224
0x9816fc
0x981755
0x981778
